## Checklist

<!--  Before submitting the pull request, ensure the following items are checked: -->

- [ ] **Code Quality**: Code follows project conventions and has been linted (`pnpm run lint`)
- [ ] **Formatting**: Code is properly formatted (`pnpm run format`)
- [ ] **Tests**: Added or updated necessary tests (unit/E2E) for new features or bug fixes (required for non-trivial changes)
- [ ] **Testing**: All tests pass locally (`pnpm run test` and/or `pnpm run test:e2e`)
- [ ] **Type Safety**: Type checks pass (`pnpm --filter ui-tars-desktop typecheck`)
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated relevant documentation in `docs/` or inline comments (required for API changes or new features)
- [ ] **Breaking Changes**: If this introduces breaking changes, they are clearly documented and migration paths are provided
- [ ] **Commit Messages**: Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format
- [ ] **Screenshots**: For UI changes, before/after screenshots are included in the PR description
- [ ] **CLA**: Ready to accept the Contributor License Agreement (CLA) when prompted
